name: Caffe Main Screen
description: Design Graph of the Caffe espresso-brewing main screen (Caffe.MainPage), an Uno Platform page composed of custom UserControls bound to MainViewModel (CommunityToolkit.Mvvm).

properties.layout: ScrollViewer > utu:AutoLayout (vertical); espresso grid and control panel reflow via utu:Responsive between one-column (Narrow) and two-column (Wide)

evidence.rationale: Unnamed Grid in MainPage.xaml holding the four EspressoCard instances.

properties.layout: Vertical utu:AutoLayout: parameters row, selection overview, brew button; sits beside the espresso grid on Wide, below it on Narrow

evidence.rationale: Unnamed AutoLayout in MainPage.xaml grouping parameters, overview and brew button.
Unnamed 3-column Grid in MainPage.xaml commented 'Parameters Panel'.

properties.accentBar: 36x3 split bar: accent-red (left) + primary (right), reversed from header

api.Espresso: EspressoItem dependency property (fills volume badge, name, description)
api.IsSelected: bool dependency property (border brush swap + checkmark visibility)
api.Tapped: routed event handled in MainPage code-behind

api.Temperature: int dependency property, TwoWay-bound to ViewModel.Temperature

api.ExtractionTime: int dependency property, TwoWay-bound to ViewModel.ExtractionTime

api.GrindLevel: GrindLevel enum dependency property (Fine|Medium|Coarse), TwoWay-bound to ViewModel.GrindLevel

api.BrewProgress: ViewModel.BrewProgress (0..1) -> cup fill height + params-text opacity pulse

properties.effect: MainContent collapsed; BrewingScreen overlay loaded and shown; cup fills with ViewModel.BrewProgress
Card border swaps to primary brush; checkmark badge becomes visible

properties.condition: ViewModel.HasSelection == false (default until a card is tapped)
properties.effect: Button background swaps to primary-disabled brush, IsEnabled=false, label reads 'Select your espresso'

properties.condition: ViewModel.HasSelection == false (default until a card is tapped)

properties.note: 35% alpha step of primary; kept as a token (rather than folded) because the brew button's modeled disabled state consumes it directly in code-behind.
Also realized as literal 'White' on internal parts (checkmark glyph, grind ellipses, overview dividers).

evidence.rationale: CornerRadius=14 recurs on EspressoCard, SelectionOverview and BrewButton; literal, no declared resource key.
16px bottom margin recurs between page sections (espresso grid, parameters panel, brew button) and as card horizontal padding; literal, no declared resource key.
ThemeShadow with Translation Z=4 recurs on EspressoCard, TemperatureGauge, ExtractionArc and GrindSelector.

properties.note: Overlay sibling of MainContent, x:Load bound to IsBrewing

unresolved.question: Should the ViewModel.HasSelection / SelectedEspresso condition be modeled as one screen-level 'selection made' state instead of (or in addition to) the three per-owner states (card-selected, brew-disabled, overview-hidden)?
unresolved.reason: One ViewModel condition drives three distinct presentation changes; per the attachment rule each was attached to the smallest changing node, but a single screen-level condition is also a defensible reading.

unresolved.question: CaffeParticleBrush (#1A1A1A) has the same value as CaffeTextPrimaryBrush — are they one semantic token?
unresolved.reason: Kept separate because the source declares two distinct resource keys; values are identical.

unresolved.question: CaffeTemperatureHighColor (#C1121F) has the same value as CaffeAccentRedBrush — are they one semantic token?
unresolved.reason: Kept separate because the source declares two distinct resource keys (Color vs SolidColorBrush); values are identical.

unresolved.question: The three parameter cards use a responsive CornerRadius (Narrow=12, Wide=16) while the other cards use 14 — is this one radius rule with responsive scaling or two intentional rules?
unresolved.reason: Only the literal 14 recurs verbatim; the responsive 12/16 pair was left as component-level detail rather than tokenized.

unresolved.question: CaffePrimaryHoverBrush (#14352A) is declared in AppResources.xaml but no file in the modeled surface references it — is it dead, or consumed by an implicit style?
unresolved.reason: Excluded per token scope and variant-folding rules (hover shade of primary, no observed consumer).

metadata.notes: Custom UserControls modeled at canonical-component altitude with internals as properties.parts; Uno Toolkit usage (utu:AutoLayout, utu:Responsive) recorded in region/screen properties; ColorPaletteOverride.xaml (Uno Themes palette) not enumerated per token scope rule since the modeled markup consumes only Caffe* resources.
